title: xPatch: Dual-Stream Time Series Forecasting with Exponential Seasonal-Trend Decomposition

split.decision: ETTh1 standard TSLib split (data_loader.py borders): train rows [0,8640), val rows [8640,11520) with 96-row context from 8544, test rows [11520,14400) with context from 11424. Agent gets the raw train and val rows (two CSVs) plus val windows; test = the every 8th of the first 2048 windows per horizon (= the released drop_last/batch-2048 protocol) materialised as window files under judge/test. Val windows mirror that: first 2048 per horizon.

baseline.timing_scope: legacy protocol estimates retained for operational budgeting; not a measured v2 reference

allowed_changes: The entire forecaster, internal feature representation, training surrogate, optimizer, regularizer and training procedure may change within the specified input and data-provenance constraints. The evaluated prediction target and loss formula remain fixed.

A submission whose only change is new values for existing settings of train.sh or run.py (batch size, learning rate, learning-rate schedule, epochs, patience, moving-average type, alpha, beta, RevIN, patch length, stride) does not count as a method improvement; this rests on patch audit.
Switching the training loss to the unused mse_criterion, or to the commented MSE or CARD variants in exp/exp_main.py, does not on its own count as a method improvement; this rests on patch audit.
fixed_contract: Forecast all seven ETTh1 variables at the four fixed horizons while satisfying the MAE guard.
The original split, every 8th of the first 2048 windows per horizon, seven channels and at most 96 input observations remain fixed.
The equal-horizon training-standardized mean MSE and mean MAE at most 0.4275 on test and 0.72 on validation remain fixed.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Do not change/drop windows, use extra history or cross-window state, introduce external pretrained weights, or alter standardization, MSE or the MAE guard.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.

evidence.finding: The score rule fixes four horizons, every 8th of 2048 windows each, seq_len<=96 and MAE at most 0.4275 on test and 0.72 on validation; the xPatch network is a baseline.
Existing scorer retains the stated target formula, aggregation and validity controls.
Reviewed the original per-window target standardization, horizon aggregation and task-specific validity conditions; all remain unchanged.

research_contract_review.verification_scope: Task-specific research-scope review and bounded checks; not a new performance/readiness certification.

validation_policy.learned_preprocessing: fit on training only; apply frozen fitted transforms to validation/test
validation_policy.instance_roles: Preserve explicit per-instance observation/training/calibration/causal-feedback roles; no evaluation-target fitting or validation-derived fitted state carried across independent cases.
validation_policy.enforcement: binding prompt and task contract; task-specific replay/guards where available; arbitrary training-data provenance requires source/patch audit
